# OmniDaily — The Shelf Gap and the Held Batch
> **GitHub-first narrative · GICS05 Consumer Staples · 2026-10-19.** Fictional educational case. GitHub is canonical; Notion is the KM hub. New names, incidents and options are illustrative. Original research and14HR child-page references remain below. Unattended synchronization is unverified.
**Start here:** [Executive One-Pager](https://github.com/nbnayak88/successlabs-case-studies/blob/main/05-consumer-staples/omnidaily-consumer-goods-ltd/executive-one-pager.md) · [Hero Story](https://github.com/nbnayak88/successlabs-case-studies/blob/main/05-consumer-staples/omnidaily-consumer-goods-ltd/hero-story.md) · [22-Section Master](https://github.com/nbnayak88/successlabs-case-studies/blob/main/05-consumer-staples/omnidaily-consumer-goods-ltd/master/README.md) · [16 Personas](https://github.com/nbnayak88/successlabs-case-studies/blob/main/05-consumer-staples/omnidaily-consumer-goods-ltd/personas/persona-cards.md) · [12 Simulations](https://github.com/nbnayak88/successlabs-case-studies/blob/main/05-consumer-staples/omnidaily-consumer-goods-ltd/simulations/README.md) · [Seven Streams](https://github.com/nbnayak88/successlabs-case-studies/blob/main/05-consumer-staples/omnidaily-consumer-goods-ltd/derived-streams/README.md) · [Resources](https://github.com/nbnayak88/successlabs-case-studies/blob/main/05-consumer-staples/omnidaily-consumer-goods-ltd/resources/README.md)
## Prologue — Availability meets trust
An invented promotion creates a shelf gap while a delayed partner feed lists stock from a quality-held batch. These learning triggers require discovery; no actual incident or causal diagnosis is asserted.
## Act I — Understand the Enterprise (ODG-M01–04)
Fictional CEO **Anika Mehra (ODG-P01)** leads a source-stipulated **USD51B** staples business with **84,000employees across57countries**, headquartered in Mumbai/Chicago.
Revenue mix:foods30%, beverages23%, home care19%, personal care18%, wellness10%. Network:78factories/co-packers,112DCs,1,900distributors,4.8Mpoints of sale and6,500partners. The source's1,600 'brands and SKUs' needs a counting definition.
The source explicitly identifies **Consumer Staples/GICS05**; this resolves the request's Discretionary wording.
[Enterprise theme](https://github.com/nbnayak88/successlabs-case-studies/blob/main/05-consumer-staples/omnidaily-consumer-goods-ltd/master/theme-a-enterprise.md)
## Act II — Choose the Future (ODG-M05–08)
Growth chief **Marcus Reed (ODG-P04)** seeks availability; quality leader **David Okoro (ODG-P07)** protects safety; CFO **James Whitfield (ODG-P02)** requires credible value.
Compare local pilots, platform first and federated demand-to-shelf experiments under common data/quality standards. Third option is provisional.
The source vision joins availability, affordability, consumer trust and sustainability;12%EBITDA improvement remains an undefined target.
[Strategy theme](https://github.com/nbnayak88/successlabs-case-studies/blob/main/05-consumer-staples/omnidaily-consumer-goods-ltd/master/theme-b-strategy.md)
## Act III — Architect Factory-to-Shelf Evidence (ODG-M09–12)
Source chain: **Sense Demand → Source → Make → Assure Quality → Distribute → Sell → Serve → Recover**.
Supply chief **Kavya Rao (ODG-P03)** and architect **Priya Nair (ODG-P13)** connect capabilities, process owners, Product/Ingredient/Customer/Outlet/Supplier360, and ERP/planning/TPM/MES/LIMS/DMS/commerce. Data chief **Sofia Alvarez (ODG-P05)** requires lineage; CISO **Omar Haddad (ODG-P12)** protects consumer, formula and partner information.
Vendor stacks are source proposals, not verified selections. Quality-release authority must constrain replenishment.
[Architecture theme](https://github.com/nbnayak88/successlabs-case-studies/blob/main/05-consumer-staples/omnidaily-consumer-goods-ltd/master/theme-c-architecture.md)
## Act IV — Fund and Sequence Evidence (ODG-M13–16)
Source proposed investment: **USD490M over36months**—manufacturing/quality190M, data/planning/AI120M, route-to-market95M, cyber/traceability50M, change35M.
Annual benefit categories total **USD400M**—revenue160M, supply productivity115M, manufacturing90M, risk35M. These are unvalidated categories, not net cash; maintenance45M may overlap manufacturing benefits.
Year1 foundations/pilots → Year2 planning, partner mobility and quality AI → Year3 replenishment, passports and optimization. No validated NPV or payback exists.
[Transformation theme](https://github.com/nbnayak88/successlabs-case-studies/blob/main/05-consumer-staples/omnidaily-consumer-goods-ltd/master/theme-d-transformation.md)
## Act V — Make It Safe and Usable (ODG-M17–19)
Plant director **Elena Petrović (ODG-P09)** demands rollback. Field director **Rohan Shah (ODG-P10)** challenges always-online assumptions. CHRO **Nandita Sen (ODG-P06)** designs role-based practice.
A bounded market/product/distributor pilot tests identifiers, late events, offline behavior, quality holds, privacy, reconciliation and operational sign-off.
[Execution theme](https://github.com/nbnayak88/successlabs-case-studies/blob/main/05-consumer-staples/omnidaily-consumer-goods-ltd/master/theme-e-execution.md)
## Act VI — Prove Value (ODG-M20–22)
Source baseline→Year3targets:forecast accuracy68%→82%; shelf availability88%→97%; yield91%→97%; quality deviations index100→65; packaging carbon index100→75; automation22%→70%. None is achieved.
Use-case improvement percentages, OTIF, line availability and enterprise scorecards need distinct definitions. The2030vision is aspirational. Scale, redesign or stop using pilot evidence.
[Value theme](https://github.com/nbnayak88/successlabs-case-studies/blob/main/05-consumer-staples/omnidaily-consumer-goods-ltd/master/theme-f-value.md)
## Meet the Fictional Stakeholders
Anika Mehra—CEO; James Whitfield—CFO; Kavya Rao—Supply Chain; Marcus Reed—Growth; Sofia Alvarez—Digital/Data; Nandita Sen—CHRO; David Okoro—Quality/Safety; Mei Lin—Product/Ingredient; Elena Petrović—Plant; Rohan Shah—Distributor/Field; Grace Mensah—Sourcing/Packaging; Omar Haddad—Security/Privacy; Priya Nair—EA; Diego Costa—Planning/AI; Amelia Brooks—Retail Customer; Asha Patel—Consumer.
[Authority, objections and withheld evidence](https://github.com/nbnayak88/successlabs-case-studies/blob/main/05-consumer-staples/omnidaily-consumer-goods-ltd/personas/persona-cards.md)
## Practice and Derive
Twelve simulations cover discovery, demand, funding, promotion, quality, adoption, security, retail service, packaging, readiness, architecture and hypothetical STAR practice.
Seven stream blueprints cover Workforce/HR, CX, Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, Business Transformation and Leadership. **14existing HR source pages** comprise13product journeys plusHR13blueprint; child bodies are not audited. External media remain planned.
[Scripts](https://github.com/nbnayak88/successlabs-case-studies/blob/main/05-consumer-staples/omnidaily-consumer-goods-ltd/simulations/scenario-scripts.md) · [Streams](https://github.com/nbnayak88/successlabs-case-studies/blob/main/05-consumer-staples/omnidaily-consumer-goods-ltd/derived-streams/README.md) · [14 HR source links](https://github.com/nbnayak88/successlabs-case-studies/blob/main/05-consumer-staples/omnidaily-consumer-goods-ltd/references/notion-child-cases.md)
## Source and Synchronization Governance
Original research remains protected. Exact narrative is mapped to a GitHub revision baseline; conflicting edits are held. Canonical changes require deliberate reconciliation; child pages and attachments are not losslessly mirrored.
[Sources and gaps](https://github.com/nbnayak88/successlabs-case-studies/blob/main/05-consumer-staples/omnidaily-consumer-goods-ltd/references/source-and-assumptions.md) · [Sync protocol](https://github.com/nbnayak88/successlabs-case-studies/blob/main/05-consumer-staples/omnidaily-consumer-goods-ltd/sync/README.md) · [Delivery report](https://github.com/nbnayak88/successlabs-case-studies/blob/main/05-consumer-staples/omnidaily-consumer-goods-ltd/delivery-report-2026-10-19.md)

# 🌟 GICS05. **OmniDaily Consumer Goods Ltd. — Digital Transformation Case Study** ## **Company Overview** **OmniDaily Consumer Goods Ltd.** is a fictional multinational consumer-staples company producing essential food, beverage, home-care, and personal-care products. The company serves households every day through a large retailer, distributor, e-commerce, and direct-to-consumer ecosystem. --- ## **📊 Company Profile**
**Attribute** **Details**
**Founded** 1976 (50 years of operations)
**Headquarters** Mumbai, India & Chicago, USA
**Global Presence** 57 countries across 6 continents
**Annual Revenue** \$51 billion USD
**Employees** 84,000 worldwide
**Households Served** 420 million annually
### **Business Portfolio**
**Business Segment** **Revenue %** **Operations**
**Foods & Nutrition** 30% Staples, snacks, dairy alternatives, packaged meals, nutrition products
**Beverages** 23% Water, juices, tea, coffee, health drinks, ready-to-drink products
**Home Care** 19% Laundry, surface care, dishwashing, air care, cleaning products
**Personal Care** 18% Skin care, oral care, hygiene, hair care, baby care
**Health & Wellness** 10% Supplements, functional nutrition, preventive-health consumer products
### **Strategic Assets** - **Manufacturing Network:** 78 factories and co-packing facilities - **Distribution Footprint:** 112 distribution centers and 1,900 distributor partners - **Product Portfolio:** 1,600 active brands and SKUs across regional markets - **Retail Reach:** products available in 4.8 million physical and digital points of sale - **Supplier Ecosystem:** 6,500 agricultural, ingredient, packaging, and logistics partners --- ## **🎯 Digital Transformation Vision** > *“Making everyday essentials more available, affordable, personalized, and sustainable through intelligent supply, trusted brands, and connected consumer experiences.”* ### **Transformation Drivers** 1. **Availability and Affordability** — maintain high service levels while managing cost volatility 2. **Demand Volatility** — respond faster to weather, local events, promotions, and shifting consumer preferences 3. **Route-to-Market Excellence** — strengthen distributor, retailer, e-commerce, and direct channels 4. **Consumer Trust** — improve product quality, traceability, safety, and transparent communication 5. **Sustainable Growth** — reduce waste, water, packaging, and carbon across the value chain --- # 🏗️ **TOGAF-Aligned Architecture Design** ## **Phase A: Architecture Vision** ### **Business Context & Stakeholders**
**Stakeholder Group** **Key Concerns** **Success Measures**
**Board & Investors** Resilient growth, margin, brand equity 12% EBITDA improvement and stronger cash conversion
**Consumers** Quality, availability, affordability, safety Higher trust and repeat-purchase rates
**Retailers & Distributors** In-stock reliability, promotions, visibility 98% on-time and in-full service
**Plant & Supply Teams** Yield, quality, safety, cost efficiency 99% critical-line availability and zero food-safety incidents
**Regulators & Communities** Product compliance, health, environment, labor 100% auditable regulatory compliance
### **Current-State Challenges** #### **Enterprise Level** - Forecasting relies heavily on historical sales and misses local demand signals - Sales, trade promotions, factory planning, and inventory decisions use disconnected data - Product and packaging information varies across markets and retail channels - Traceability, quality investigations, and sustainability reporting involve manual reconciliations #### **Technology Level** - 160+ applications with overlapping planning, sales, quality, and customer-data capabilities - Legacy ERP, manufacturing, and distributor-management platforms delay decisions - Limited visibility from raw materials through production, distribution, shelf availability, and consumer feedback - Point-to-point integrations make product launches and mergers slower and more expensive --- ## **Phase B: Business Architecture** ### **Value Stream Mapping** ```plain text CONSUMER STAPLES VALUE CHAIN TRANSFORMATION Sense Demand → Source → Make → Assure Quality → Distribute → Sell → Serve → Recover Current State: Forecast-led, fragmented, reactive execution Future State: Demand-sensing, connected, resilient, sustainable operations ``` ### **Core Business Capabilities**
**Capability Domain** **Current Maturity** **Target Maturity** **Digital Enablers**
**Demand Planning** Level 2 — Historical forecast Level 4 — Demand sensing AI forecasting, external signals
**Trade Promotion Management** Level 2 — Spreadsheet-led Level 4 — Optimized investment Revenue-growth management analytics
**Manufacturing & Quality** Level 2 — Local reporting Level 4 — Intelligent operations MES, IoT, vision AI, digital twins
**Distribution & Execution** Level 2 — Channel-specific Level 4 — Connected route-to-market Control tower, mobile sales tools
**Sustainability & Traceability** Level 1 — Manual reporting Level 4 — Product-level transparency Digital product passport, ESG data platform
### **Operating Model Evolution** #### **From: Brand and Function Silos** - Brands, sales regions, factories, and supply planning optimize independently - Trade promotions are evaluated after execution rather than improved in real time - Sales representatives and distributors have incomplete outlet, inventory, and consumer insight #### **To: Connected Consumer Staples Ecosystem** - An integrated planning rhythm connects consumer demand to supply, production, and distribution - Shared commercial dashboards improve pricing, promotion, assortment, and shelf availability - Factories use real-time quality, yield, and energy data to improve every production run --- ## **Phase C: Information Systems Architecture** ### **Data Architecture (DAMA-DMBOK Aligned)**
**Data Domain** **Critical Data** **Quality Requirements** **Governance Model**
**Consumer & Household** Preferences, consent, loyalty, support, feedback Consent-compliant and de-duplicated Customer-data office
**Product & Ingredient** Formula, claims, allergens, packaging, nutrition, cost Complete, versioned, compliant Product stewardship
**Demand & Commercial** Sales, pricing, promotions, outlet execution, market signals Timely, trusted, governed metrics Revenue-growth management council
**Manufacturing & Quality** Batch, yield, lab results, downtime, release status Traceable and validated Plant and quality ownership
**Supplier & ESG** Origin, certification, water, waste, emissions, packaging Auditable end-to-end lineage Responsible-sourcing office
### **Master Data Management Strategy** ```plain text CONSUMER STAPLES GOLDEN RECORDS Product 360° → Ingredient 360° → Customer 360° → Outlet 360° → Supplier 360° A central MDM hub governs core definitions while market and factory teams own local accuracy, regulatory content, and timely updates. ``` ### **Target Application Landscape**
**Application Layer** **Core Systems** **Architecture Pattern**
**Experience Layer** Consumer apps, brand sites, retailer portal, distributor and sales-rep apps Mobile-first, API-enabled experiences
**Process Layer** ERP, demand planning, TPM, MES, LIMS, DMS, CRM, e-commerce Domain services and workflow automation
**Integration Layer** iPaaS, B2B gateway, event mesh, supplier integration hub API-first, pub/sub, event streaming
**Data Layer** Lakehouse, MDM, product-information platform, quality historian, ESG platform Governed data products and real-time analytics
--- ## **Phase D: Technology Architecture** ### **Hybrid Smart-Manufacturing and Commerce Strategy**
**Workload Type** **Deployment Model** **Rationale**
**Factory Controls & Quality Systems** Edge + private cloud Low-latency operations, safety, and resilience
**ERP & Core Finance** Private cloud Control, compliance, and enterprise integration
**Demand, Sales & AI Analytics** Public cloud Elastic compute and scalable data science
**Consumer Experiences** Public cloud Global performance and campaign scalability
**Supplier & Distributor Collaboration** Hybrid cloud Secure B2B connectivity across partners
### **Technology Standards**
**Technology Stack** **Standard Choice** **Strategic Rationale**
**Manufacturing Connectivity** OPC UA + MQTT Interoperable, secure industrial data exchange
**Data & AI Platform** Snowflake + Databricks Scalable commercial and operations analytics
**Integration Platform** SAP Integration Suite + Kafka Reliable enterprise and event integration
**Mobile Sales Platform** Cloud-native field-force platform Offline-capable outlet execution and distributor collaboration
**Identity & Access** Microsoft Entra ID Centralized zero-trust access control
--- # 🤖 **AI & Advanced Analytics Architecture** ## **AI Use Case Portfolio** ### **Tier 1: Commercial and Supply AI**
**Use Case** **Business Value** **Technical Approach** **Implementation Timeline**
**Demand Sensing** 12% forecast-accuracy improvement Time-series AI with weather, retail, and social signals 5 months
**Trade Promotion Optimization** 8% better promotion ROI Causal models and scenario optimization 7 months
**Dynamic Replenishment** 18% fewer stock-outs Inventory optimization and store-level forecasting 8 months
### **Tier 2: Operations, Quality, and Sustainability AI**
**Use Case** **Business Value** **Technical Approach** **Implementation Timeline**
**Predictive Quality** 25% reduction in quality deviations Multivariate process analytics and computer vision 6 months
**Predictive Maintenance** \$45M annual value Anomaly detection and asset-health models 6 months
**Sustainable Packaging Optimizer** Lower material and carbon intensity Lifecycle data and optimization AI 9 months
### **Responsible AI Framework** ```plain text RESPONSIBLE STAPLES AI Trusted consumer consent → validated product and quality data → human review for commercial and safety-critical recommendations → bias, drift, and model-performance monitoring → auditable decisions and controlled deployment ``` --- # 🔐 **Security & Risk Architecture** ## **Zero Trust Across Consumer, Enterprise, and Factory Environments**
**Asset Category** **Security Controls** **Risk Level**
**Consumer Identity & Data** Consent management, encryption, tokenization, fraud controls **Critical**
**Quality & Formula Data** Role-based access, audit trails, DLP **High**
**Factory OT Networks** Segmentation, allowlisting, monitored remote access **Critical**
**Distributor & Supplier APIs** API security, partner identity, rate limiting **High**
--- # 🌐 **Integration & Interoperability** ## **Event-Driven Consumer Staples Model** ```plain text VALUE-CHAIN EVENTS Demand Signal → Production Plan → Batch Produced → Quality Released → Shipment Dispatched → Store Replenished → Consumer Feedback → Recovery Events create timely, trusted visibility from raw material to household use. ``` ### **API Strategy**
**API Type** **Use Cases** **Governance**
**Internal APIs** Planning, production, quality, pricing, finance, inventory Private, versioned, monitored
**Partner APIs** Retailers, distributors, logistics, suppliers, co-packers Authenticated, contract-based, rate-limited
**Consumer APIs** Product information, loyalty, support, traceability, consent Documented, privacy-aware, resilient
--- # 📊 **Digital Transformation Roadmap** ## **3-Year Implementation Timeline**
**Phase** **Key Initiatives** **Success Metrics**
**Year 1 — Foundation** Product and customer MDM, data governance, factory connectivity, demand-sensing pilot 95% product-data completeness; 20% priority lines connected
**Year 2 — Acceleration** Integrated planning, trade-promotion analytics, distributor mobility, quality AI rollout 10% forecast improvement; 12% fewer stock-outs
**Year 3 — Transformation** Autonomous replenishment, digital product passports, smart-factory optimization 20% waste reduction; 70% digital process automation
--- # 💰 **Business Case & Value Realization** ## **Investment Overview**
**Investment Category** **3-Year Budget** **Key Allocations**
**Smart Manufacturing & Quality** \$190M MES, connectivity, quality systems, edge computing
**Data, Planning & AI Platform** \$120M Lakehouse, demand sensing, commercial analytics, MDM
**Route-to-Market Modernization** \$95M Distributor tools, sales mobility, retail execution, B2B integration
**Cybersecurity & Traceability** \$50M Zero trust, food-safety traceability, partner security
**Change & Capability Building** \$35M Digital skills, adoption, product teams
**Total Investment** **\$490M** **Staged deployment over 36 months**
### **Expected Returns** - **Revenue Growth:** \$160M annual benefit from improved availability, assortment, and promotion effectiveness - **Supply Chain Productivity:** \$115M annual benefit from better planning, inventory, and logistics decisions - **Manufacturing Efficiency:** \$90M annual benefit from increased yield, reduced downtime, and lower waste - **Risk Mitigation:** \$35M annual benefit from quality, compliance, and cyber-resilience improvements - **Strategic Value:** stronger brand trust and measurable progress in sustainable products and packaging --- # 🎯 **Success Metrics & KPIs**
**Metric** **Baseline** **Year 1 Target** **Year 3 Target**
**Forecast Accuracy** 68% 74% 82%
**On-Shelf Availability** 88% 93% 97%
**Manufacturing Yield** 91% 94% 97%
**Quality Deviations** 100 index 85 index 65 index
**Packaging Carbon Intensity** 100 index 92 index 75 index
**Digital Process Automation** 22% 45% 70%
--- # 🚀 **Critical Success Factors** ## **Leadership & Governance** - A Chief Digital, Supply Chain, and Growth Council aligned on shared commercial and operational outcomes - Data owners accountable for product, customer, demand, quality, and supplier information - Cross-functional product teams linking brands, sales, factory operations, supply planning, and technology ## **Architecture Principles** 1. **Consumer Trust First** — quality, safety, availability, and transparent information guide every decision 2. **One Demand Signal** — shared demand sensing connects commercial actions with supply response 3. **Data as a Product** — trusted, governed data assets are reusable across brands and markets 4. **Factory-to-Shelf Visibility** — real-time events provide traceability from batch to outlet 5. **Sustainable by Design** — embed waste, water, packaging, and carbon objectives into core processes --- # 🔮 **Future-State Vision** ## **2030: OmniDaily as a Trusted, Intelligent Everyday-Essentials Leader** - Demand-sensing and autonomous replenishment keep essential products available in every market - Smart factories improve yield, safety, quality, energy use, and waste performance in real time - Retailers, distributors, and field teams collaborate through one connected route-to-market platform - Consumers access trusted product, ingredient, nutrition, and sustainability information through digital product passports - Circular packaging and regenerative sourcing become measurable, scalable features of everyday consumer value --- # 🎉 **Conclusion** **OmniDaily Consumer Goods Ltd.’s digital transformation** evolves the business from disconnected consumer-goods operations into a demand-led, intelligent, and trusted staples ecosystem. By combining TOGAF-aligned architecture, data governance, smart manufacturing, route-to-market integration, and responsible AI, OmniDaily can improve product availability, affordability, quality, and sustainability at global scale. **Key to success:** a shared demand signal, trusted product and consumer data, factory-to-shelf visibility, and cross-functional teams focused on everyday consumer value. --- ## 14. Aligned business transformation case study blueprint ## Alignment purpose This section refines OmniDaily into the same business transformation case study structure used for OmniSpace while preserving the existing case content. ### 14.1 Executive case narrative OmniDaily Consumer Goods Ltd. is transforming from forecast-led consumer-staples operations into a demand-sensing, factory-to-shelf, trusted, sustainable everyday-essentials ecosystem. **Core transformation statement:** OmniDaily is not only improving supply chain tools; it is building a connected operating model where demand signals, product data, manufacturing quality, route-to-market execution, consumer trust, ESG performance, and value realization work together. ### 14.2 Business problem statement
**Problem area** **Current challenge** **Transformation need**
Demand volatility Historical forecasts miss weather, events, promotion, retail, and consumer signals. Build demand sensing and integrated planning.
Disconnected route-to-market Distributor, retailer, e-commerce, and field sales data are not fully connected. Create a connected route-to-market platform and shared execution data.
Product-data complexity Formula, packaging, claims, allergens, and nutrition data vary across markets. Govern Product 360 and Ingredient 360 with compliant product information.
Quality and traceability gaps Batch, lab, factory, supplier, and shelf data require manual reconciliation. Connect factory-to-shelf events, quality systems, and traceability controls.
Sustainability pressure Packaging, water, waste, sourcing, and carbon performance must be measurable. Build ESG data products and sustainable packaging intelligence.
### 14.3 Target transformation operating model ```plain text Business Outcomes ↓ Capability Architecture — Demand, product, manufacturing, quality, route-to-market, ESG ↓ Process Architecture — Sense demand to source, make, sell, serve, and recover ↓ Data Architecture — Product, ingredient, customer, outlet, supplier, quality golden records ↓ Application Architecture — ERP, planning, TPM, MES, LIMS, DMS, CRM, e-commerce ↓ Integration Architecture — B2B gateway, APIs, event mesh, supplier and distributor hubs ↓ Technology Architecture — Smart manufacturing, AI, lakehouse, mobile sales, cloud ↓ Adoption, Trust, Sustainability, and Value Realization ``` **Operating rule:** Every workstream must connect a shared demand signal to product data, factory capacity, inventory, channel execution, quality, ESG, adoption, and business value. ### 14.4 Workstream alignment map
**Workstream** **Business outcome** **Architecture / process focus** **Delivery and adoption focus**
Demand sensing Better availability and lower excess inventory. Demand data, promotion, weather, retail signals. AI forecasting, integrated planning, commercial adoption.
Smart manufacturing and quality Higher yield, fewer deviations, safer products. MES, LIMS, batch, lab, quality-release process. Factory connectivity, vision AI, operator dashboards.
Route-to-market modernization Improved distributor, retailer, and field execution. Outlet 360, DMS, mobile sales, replenishment. Sales mobility, partner APIs, control tower.
Sustainability and traceability Trusted product, packaging, sourcing, and ESG transparency. Ingredient 360, supplier data, packaging lifecycle. Digital product passports, ESG dashboards, supplier collaboration.
### 14.5 Case study structure for publishing 1. **Situation** - OmniDaily serves households through food, beverage, home-care, personal-care, health, retail, distributor, and digital channels. 2. **Challenge** - It must improve availability, affordability, quality, traceability, route-to-market execution, and sustainable growth. 3. **Transformation approach** - Use demand sensing, smart manufacturing, MDM, route-to-market integration, responsible AI, and ESG data governance. 4. **Execution model** - Govern product and customer data, connect factories, modernize planning, empower distributors, and automate quality and traceability. 5. **Value realization** - Measure forecast accuracy, on-shelf availability, manufacturing yield, quality deviations, packaging carbon intensity, and automation. 6. **Long-term capability** - Build a repeatable consumer-staples transformation model from demand signal to household use and recovery. ### 14.6 Alignment rules - **One demand signal:** Commercial and supply decisions must use a shared demand view. - **Product trust first:** Product, ingredient, quality, and claims data must be governed. - **Factory-to-shelf visibility:** Trace batches, inventory, and service performance end to end. - **Route-to-market connected:** Distributor, retailer, and field teams need one execution model. - **Sustainability embedded:** Packaging, sourcing, waste, water, and carbon are core metrics. - **Value after go-live:** Track benefits continuously. ### 14.7 Final aligned positioning ## Aligned case study positioning OmniDaily Consumer Goods Ltd. demonstrates how everyday-consumer transformation becomes measurable when demand sensing, product data, smart manufacturing, route-to-market execution, quality, sustainability, and value realization operate as one connected system.
